items.text: AMEND AND RECOMMIT TO HIGHER EDUCATION

items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S5585

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend the education law, in relation to requiring the board
of trustees of SUNY, CUNY and HESC to make publicly available agendas
and subsequent meeting records


 PURPOSE :
This bill requires the Board of Trustees of the State University, City
University, and Higher Education Services Corporation to make publicly
available the agendas of all committees and subcommittees three days
before the meeting on their website. No later than seven days after
the meeting the Board must make available the minutes, attendance,
transcripts and voting record of the meeting. This information must
remain available for no less than ten years after the meeting.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :
(State University) Section 1. Subdivision 2 of section 353 of the
education law is amended to: require that the Board of Trustees of the
State University of New York to post the agenda of the meeting three
days in advance of the meeting. Also that the minutes, attendance,
transcripts and voting record of the meeting be posted no later than 7
days after the meeting electronically on their website, and to be kept
available there for no less than 10 years.

(State University) § 2. Subdivision 4 of section 353 of the education
law is amended to: require that the meetings of any such committee or
subcommittee of the Board of Trustees have an agenda available three
days before the meeting, and that the minutes, attendance, transcripts
and voting record of the meeting be posted no later than 7 days after
the meeting, electronically on their website, and to be kept available
there for no less than 10 years.

(City University) § 3. Subdivision 3 of section 6204 of the education
law is amended to: require that the Board of Trustees of the City
University of New York to post the agenda of the meeting three days in
advance of the meeting.  Also that the minutes, attendance,
transcripts and voting record of the meeting be posted no later than 7
days after the meeting electronically on their website, and to be kept
available there for no less than 10 years. All Committees that fall
under the purview will also be subject to posting the agenda three
days before the meeting and no later than 7 days after the meeting
they must post the minutes, attendance, transcripts, and voting record
of the meeting.  These items must be kept electronically on the
website to be accessed for no less than 10 years after the meeting.

(Higher Education Services Corporation) § 4. Subdivision 7 of section
652 of the education law is amended to: Require that the agenda for
the Board of Trustees of the Higher Education Services Corporation to
be posted three days in advance of the meeting. Also that the minutes,
attendance, transcripts and voting record of the meeting be posted no
later than 7 days after the meeting electronically on their website,
and to be kept available there for no less than 10 years. Also that
any such meeting of the Board or Trustees be conducted in accordance
with public officers law.

 JUSTIFICATION :
This bill would increase the transparency for the Boards of Trustees
of our higher educational institutions in New York State. Since
members of these boards are not elected by the general public and do
not serve a constituency, their meetings should be open and available
at all times so that all New Yorkers have the ability to understand
the decision making process that goes into life altering decisions
such as tuition increases. The availability of these meetings will
open the process to all New Yorkers who wish to be part of, and
understand the process of the governing boards of higher education in
New York.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
None.

 FISCAL IMPACT :
None.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This bill shall take effect immediately.

B.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S5585B

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend the education law, in relation to requiring the board
of trustees of SUNY, CUNY and HESC to make publicly available agendas
and subsequent meeting records


 PURPOSE :
This bill requires the Board of Trustees of the State University, City
University, and Higher Education Services Corporation to make publicly
available the agendas of all committees and subcommittees three days
before the meeting on their website. No later than seven days after
the meeting the Board must make available the minutes, attendance,
transcripts and voting record of the meeting. This information must
remain available for no less than ten years after the meeting.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :
(State University) Section 1. Subdivision 2 of section 353 of the
education law is amended to: require that the Board of Trustees of the
State University of New York to post the agenda of the meeting three
days in advance of the meeting. Also that the minutes, attendance,
transcripts and voting record of the meeting be posted no later than 7
days after the meeting electronically on their website, and to be kept
available there for no less than 10 years.  Unless an executive
committee meeting has been called in which an agenda must be available
48 hours in advance.

(State University) § 2. Subdivision 4 of section 353 of the education
law is amended to: require that the meetings of any such committee or
subcommittee of the Board of Trustees have an agenda available three
days before the meeting. A summary of resolutions, board actions, and
voting record for any such meeting of the board of trustees shall be
electronically available on the state university of New York website
no later than seven days after the meeting, and shall be considered
public records. The minutes, attendance, transcripts and voting record
of the meeting be posted no later than 7 days after the meeting it has
been approved, electronically on their website, and to be kept
available there for no less than 10 years.

(City University) § 3. Subdivision 3 of section 6204 of the education
law is amended to: require that the Board of Trustees of the City
University of New York to post the agenda of the meeting three days in
advance of the meeting. Unless a special meeting has been called in
which an agenda must be available 48 hours in advance. A summary of
resolutions, board actions, and voting record for any such meeting of
the board of trustees shall be electronically available on the city
university website. Also the minutes, attendance, transcripts and
voting record of the meeting be posted no later than 7 days after the
meeting in which they were approved, electronically on their website,
and to be kept available there for no less than 10 years.  All
Committees that fall under the purview will also be subject to posting
the agenda three days before the meeting and no later than 7 days
after the meeting in which they were approved they must post the
minutes, attendance, transcripts, and voting record of the meeting.
These items must be kept electronically on the website to be accessed
for no less than 10 years after the meeting.

(Higher Education Services Corporation) § 4. subdivision 7 of section
652 of the education law is amended to: Require that the agenda for
the Board of Trustees of the Higher Education Services Corporation to
be posted three days in advance of the meeting. Also that the minutes,
attendance, transcripts and voting record of the meeting be posted no
later than 7 days after the meeting electronically on their website,
and to be kept available there for no less than 10 years.  Also that

any such meeting of the Board or Trustees be conducted in accordance
with public officers law.

 JUSTIFICATION :
This bill would increase the transparency for the Boards of Trustees
of our higher educational institutions in New York State. Since
members of these boards are not elected by the general public and do
not serve a constituency, their meetings should be open and available
at all times so that all New Yorkers have the ability to understand
the decision making process that goes into life altering decisions
such as tuition increases. The availability of these meetings will
open the process to all New Yorkers who wish to be part of, and
understand the process of the governing boards of higher education in
New York.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
None.

 FISCAL IMPACT :
None.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This bill shall take effect immediately.

C.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S5585C

TITLE OF BILL:
An act to amend the education law, in relation to requiring the board of
trustees  of  SUNY, CUNY and HESC to make publicly available agendas and
subsequent meeting records

PURPOSE:
This bill requires the Board of Trustees of the State  University,  City
University,  and  Higher Education Services Corporation to make publicly
available the agendas of all committees  and  subcommittees  three  days
before  the  meeting on their website. The approved minutes, attendance,
transcripts or video recording, and voting record of the meeting must be
available no later than seven days after their approval  by  the  board,
committee  or sub-committee.  This information must remain available for
no less than ten years after the meeting. A summary of  resolutions  and
board actions must be available no later than seven days after the meet-
ing.

If  an  executive  committee meeting has been called, the agenda must be
available 24 hours in advance.

JUSTIFICATION:
This bill would increase the transparency for the Boards of Trustees  of
our  higher educational institutions in New York State. Since members of
these boards are not elected by the general public and do  not  serve  a
constituency,  their  meetings should be open and available at all times
so that all New Yorkers have the  ability  to  understand  the  decision
making  process  that  goes into life altering decisions such as tuition
increases. The availability of these meetings will open the  process  to
all  New  Yorkers  who wish to be part of, and understand the process of
the governing boards of higher education in New York.

LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:
Reported out of the Higher Education committee 2009.

FISCAL IMPACT:
None.

EFFECTIVE DATE:
This bill shall take effect immediately.
